items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: Then when he got out, he joined me. Oh, God -- Conrad Gazzo.

ctx.x: Yeah, very early in the war, he was the lead trumpet player with Claude Thornhill's band which was a very musical and very beautiful band. And then I think during part of that war period, I believe he was with the Artie Shaw band, in the Navy. Then when he got out, he joined me. Oh, God -- Conrad Gazzo.
